name: agent-workflow-harness
description: A tracked, gated workflow for agent-run repositories: one task in flight, done-checks proven red before the build, a goal gate, a five-item review gate, human-gated merges, and a task that is not finished until its outcome is recorded.

owner.title: Repository owner
owner.description: The person the skills hand decisions to — plan approvals, per-slice diff review, and the two merge gates. Shown by name in the workflow skills.

gh_repo.title: GitHub repository (owner/name)
gh_repo.description: The gh --repo target for the PR guards. Set this where `origin` is a read-only upstream fork, otherwise the guards query the wrong repository and silently pass.

remote.title: Push remote
remote.description: The git remote the skills tell you to push to. Left as origin unless this repo pushes somewhere else.
